title: TriggerDataEvent
description: Message published to the trigger.data Kafka topic — by ui-gateway for data_refresh/data_quality_check, or by the daily native CronJob for full_pipeline (a value never exposed through POST /analyses — the caller-facing contract only knows the two on-demand analysis values). Consumed by data-runner's `consume` mode.

runId.description: UUID for on-demand analyses (minted by ui-gateway, returned as `id` on POST /analyses); deterministic `daily-<YYYY-MM-DD>` for the CronJob-triggered full_pipeline run — queryable via GET /analyses/{id} without needing to discover the id from logs.

updateKey.description: Credential for PATCH /analyses/{id}. Travels only on this message — never in the HTTP 202 — so only the consumer can update status. Omitted on full_pipeline, which the CronJob publishes without going through the gateway.
